notes: Bug: 'files.filter is not a function' on image drag-and-drop. Root cause: FileDropHandler.js passed raw FileList (from e.dataTransfer.files) to the callback, but FileList is array-like and lacks .filter(). The lifecycle callback at createCollageLifecycle.js line 262 called files.filter() directly on the FileList. Fix: (1) FileDropHandler.js: wrap e.dataTransfer.files with Array.from() before passing to callback, matching its documented contract of File[]. (2) createCollageLifecycle.js: add Array.from(files) as defensive measure before .filter(). All 36 test suites pass (0 failures).
